analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 51.7 to 61.7, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from 1.7266 to 5.5988, strengthening upward momentum. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the current price rising relative to the 5-day low. Considering the high volatility of a 3x leveraged product, a stop loss is set at 1.3x ATR.
